question.text: Which of the following is the MINIMUM corpus that each scheme of an AIF must have under SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7 section on minimum corpus: each scheme of the AIF shall have a total corpus (total capital commitments) of not less than INR 20 crore. The Trap: Option A is half the rule. Option C conflates with the merchant banker fund threshold. Option D fabricates. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C all test this — it is a core compliance number. Also relevant for III-A (Compliance). Manager's Pro-Tip: Do not declare first close until you have hard commitments above INR 20 crore. A SEBI letter asking why you closed below the regulatory floor is not a conversation you want.
